subject: Thanks for trying Redwood — schedule a quick walkthrough

Cc: hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for trying Redwood — schedule a quick walkthrough

Hi Lucy,

Thanks for starting a trial of Redwood Inference — welcome! We created a temporary project for you and seeded it with example prompts so you can try the runtime immediately.

Quick next steps (pick whatever fits):
- Try the hosted quickstart in your project (no infra): https://app.redwood.ai/console/quickstart
- Book a 15-minute technical intro (fast Q&A) or a 45-minute demo (deep dive + architecture) using our timezone-aware picker: https://cal.redwood.ai/selfsignup?tz=auto

Attached: redwood-quickstart.pdf (quick checklist).

If you prefer, one of our SDRs can reach out to coordinate a time.

Thanks,
The Redwood Onboarding Team
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 10:20:00 -0700

Hi Lucy — Monica here from Redwood (SDR team). Happy to set up a quick session to show the parts of the product most useful for your team. I saw you started the trial — congrats!

If a short orientation is best, 15 minutes works to cover the console, API keys, and one example workload. If you want an engineer-facing deep dive (memory/latency/cost tradeoffs) we can do 45 minutes and bring an engineer.

Pick one of these localized times (I set them in your timezone):
- Monday Jul 13 — 11:30 AM PT (15m)
- Monday Jul 13 — 2:00 PM PT (45m)
- Tuesday Jul 14 — 4:00 PM PT (15m)

Or use the live picker: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/monica/15-45 — the widget shows only windows that match your trial region.

Attached is a 15-minute agenda and I'll send an .ics once you confirm a slot. If you could also let me know whether you'll have engineers on the call, I can tailor the demo.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
